title: The relationship of the internal space of buildings design with human behavior

findings.consequent: Demand for 'colors & agriculture in work area'
findings.mechanism: Colors and natural elements are perceived to contribute to positive feelings and well-being, leading to higher demand.
findings.quote: the employee of age 31 – 40 were the highest response about demanding colors & agriculture

findings.consequent: Demand for 'colors & agriculture in work area'
findings.mechanism: Implied lower perceived need or different priorities for these elements compared to other age groups.
findings.quote: comparing to the group of age at 51-60 which has the lowest demand of that issue

findings.consequent: Demand for 'nice view in the office'
findings.mechanism: Views, especially natural ones, are perceived to provide mental restoration and reduce stress.
findings.quote: but they have the highest demand of needing nice view in the office

findings.mechanism: Need for personal space and control over social interaction and identity.
findings.quote: nearly equal to the group of age 41-50 in needing their own private area.

findings.mechanism: Need for personal space and control over social interaction and identity.
findings.quote: nearly equal to the group of age 41-50 in needing their own private area.

findings.consequent: Demand for 'gathering area at work area'
findings.mechanism: Need for social interaction, collaboration, and community building.
findings.quote: the group of age 41 -50 has the highest demand.

stimuli.description: Survey questions implicitly asking about preferences for environmental features like colors, agriculture, views, private areas, and gathering areas in the workplace.

tables.description: Chart showing the distribution of survey participants by employment sector (government vs. private).
Bar chart showing employee responses (demand levels) for different environmental features across various age groups (23-31, 31-40, 41-50, 51-60).
key_stats: Highest demand for 'colors & agriculture' in age group 31-40
Lowest demand for 'colors & agriculture' in age group 51-60
Highest demand for 'nice view' in age group 51-60
Highest demand for 'own private area' in age group 41-50 (and nearly equal for 51-60)
Highest demand for 'gathering area' in age group 41-50
